disable_default_sink.description: If set to true, the _Default sink in newly created projects and folders will created in a disabled state. This can be used to automatically disable log storage if there is already an aggregated sink configured in the hierarchy. The _Default sink can be re-enabled manually if needed.
disable_default_sink.rationale: Disabling the _Default sink prevents logs from being stored in the default logging bucket. If not replaced with an alternative aggregated sink, critical logs may be lost, creating security blind spots and violating compliance requirements for log retention.

folder.description: The folder for which to retrieve settings.
folder.rationale: This identifies which folder's logging settings are being configured. It has no direct security impact on the settings themselves.

kms_key_name.description: The resource name for the configured Cloud KMS key.
kms_key_name.rationale: Customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) provide control over encryption of log data. Without CMEK, Google-managed encryption is used which may not meet compliance requirements for HIPAA, SOC2, or PCI DSS. CMEK allows key rotation, revocation, and audit trail of key usage.

storage_location.description: The storage location that Cloud Logging will use to create new resources when a location is needed but not explicitly provided.
storage_location.rationale: Sets the default region Cloud Logging uses when creating new log storage resources for the folder/organization. Data residency is a sanctioned archetype: a policy should require it to be within an approved region whitelist so default log storage stays in permitted jurisdictions; the whitelist may be a hardcoded example set and is repurposable by swapping the list.
